title: ampelocissus cavicaulis
intro: Ampelocissus cavicaulis, commonly known as Indian vine or Cavish, is a plant species in the grape family (Vitaceae) that is native to the Indian subcontinent. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Ampelocissus cavicaulis include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ampelocissus cavicaulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
